# CANDIDATE: VIX_20_RISING_FLAT_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring VIX>=20 and rising/flat at entry will improve bearish trade selection by filtering entries when options market fear is insufficient (VIX<20 or falling). This should reduce losses on marginal bearish days (like 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) while preserving wins on high-conviction days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) where VIX was already elevated and rising/flat.

## Mechanism

Add filter to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entry path: 
- Entry allowed only if (VIX >= 20) AND (current VIX >= prior bar's VIX) 
- Uses same VIX data source as existing VIX confirmation in playbook 
- Replaces existing "VIX rising OR already above 20" condition with stricter "VIX>=20 AND not falling" 
- Applied at trigger evaluation time (same as other context filters)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (based on ITM-2 stop sizing and 50% risk cap)
2. **Sample bias:** Testing on 16-month SPY 5m dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Filter condition derived from anchor days creates overfit risk; requires OOS walk-forward to validate robustness
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will perform walk-forward held-out window after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate top 3 J days with OPRA cached fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Missing 5/04 winner if VIX<20 or falling (unlikely given +$730 P&L)
   - Max drawdown: Increased if filter causes consecutive loser streaks
   - Blow-up scenario: VIX data gap causing false entries (mitigated by data validation)
6. **Concentration:** TBD after backtest (will disclose if top-5 days exceed 60% of P&L)
